item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine and very hot weather to southern China for the rest of this week and next week. Besides, an upper-air disturbance will bring a few showers to the northern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow.

Date/Month: 15/07 (Friday)
Wind: Southwest force 2 to 3.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers.
Temp range: 28 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 16/07 (Saturday)
Wind: Southwest force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Sunny periods and one or two showers. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
